Struct StateBahn

Namespace
TwinSharp.CNC
Assembly
TwinSharp.dll

Real-time status of the CNC path interpolator, mirroring the STATE_BAHN PLC struct. Accessed via HLI_Global_Variables.gpCh[n]^.bahn_state. Read in a single ADS call via State.
